_doc: #1173 NO FOLDER RULE IS DECLARED IN THE APK any more: the Fsync page draws real state only (the rsync jobs, Unison pairs, rclone remotes and FUSE mounts the user made, kept by Cloud Account). The `rules` array stays as an empty list so the baked SYNC_RULES_B64 and its parser keep their shape; it must stay empty (DeclarationsTest holds it).
_doc_auth: Same rule as every other file in data/: no password, no token and no key ever appears here. `remote_name` names a remote whose credential the user adds on the device (Configs ▸ Rsync ▸ Remotes ▸ Edit); a rule whose remote is unreachable renders its declared reason, it does not silently fail.
_doc_direction: upload = local → remote (rclone copy), download = remote → local (rclone copy), bidirectional = rclone bisync. copy never deletes; bisync needs a --resync on its very first run, which the engine screen offers as a flag.
_doc_unison: #1173 Unison POLICY only: `defaults` and the shared `ignore` rules every user-made pair inherits (storage/UnisonPairs.kt lays the user's pairs over this and hands the result to libs:rclone's UnisonConfig.parse). `pairs` is empty and stays empty: a pair in the APK would be sample data.

unison._doc: defaults apply to every pair that does not override them. `ignore` is Unison's own grammar (Name|Path|BelowPath|Regex <pattern>) and every pair gets these plus its own. batch/auto: the engine runs unattended (there is no terminal on a phone), so a non-conflicting change is applied and a conflicting one is SKIPPED and listed in the Sync tab for a keep-A / keep-B / keep-both decision. fastcheck: default | true | false | yes | no, Unison's own. prefer: absent = ask (every conflict waits for the user), a | b = that side wins (a is the phone), newer | older = by modification time; a pair that picks a winner must keep backup on (parsing refuses a silent overwrite), and what a winner replaces is kept in the engine's private central backup (max_backups copies). root_a is a folder RELATIVE to shared storage, resolved at runtime (the engine runs in its own uid and cannot open another app's private data; no device path is written down). root_b is either {host: <name>.app, user, path, port?, mount?, server_cmd?} (SSH over the mesh; `mount` names a Sync > Mounts ssh connection whose key the engine uses, else the first ssh mount on that host and user) or {path} for another local folder. schedule_minutes (>= 15) is enforced by UnisonSyncWorker on the existing WorkManager; absent = manual (Sync now). require_unmetered holds scheduled runs to Wi-Fi.
